{"id":1817940469,"question_id":3501,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"8 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1762021202,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"117 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1817940469/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Delete Nodes From Linked List Present in Array","memory":"263.4 MB","code":"/**\n * Definition for singly-linked list.\n * struct ListNode {\n *     int val;\n *     ListNode *next;\n *     ListNode() : val(0), next(nullptr) {}\n *     ListNode(int x) : val(x), next(nullptr) {}\n *     ListNode(int x, ListNode *next) : val(x), next(next) {}\n * };\n */\nclass Solution {\npublic:\n    ListNode* modifiedList(vector<int>& nums, ListNode* head) {\n        unordered_set<int>st;\n        for(auto num : nums) st.insert(num);\n\n        ListNode* dummy = new ListNode(-1);\n        dummy->next = head;\n        ListNode* curr = dummy;\n\n        while(curr->next)\n        {\n            if(st.find(curr->next->val) != st.end())\n            {\n                curr->next = curr->next->next;\n            }\n            else\n                curr = curr->next;\n        }\n        return dummy->next;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"delete-nodes-from-linked-list-present-in-array","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1050}
